name: LeoKaiser
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Shawn Ye
rules: GO MEGA-NEKO-KAISER! -- COST – Deplete a card named "PantherKaiser" you control. Deplete a card named "TigerKaiser" you control. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains 8 strength, 8 life, and 2 speed and while it is the only member of an attacking party, it cannot be blocked by parties with less than 3 members.
notes: Catalog: 'only parties with at least 3 members can block it' = printed 'cannot be blocked by parties with less than 3 members'. Footer has no Art: credit; artist (Shawn Ye) is only in the subtitle.

name: Micromajig Shipping Container
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Alex Ang
rules: If this card is destroyed, put 5 Micromajig tokens into play under your control. -- (Treat Micromajig tokens as Gearsmith character cards with 1 strength, 1 life, and 3 speed. If a Micromajig token would leave play, remove it from the game instead.)
notes: Printed token reminder gives tokens 1 strength, 1 life, 3 speed and NO majig subtype; catalog adds 'and the majig subtype' (could change subtype synergies). Printed type line is 'container' but catalog subtype is 'machine'. Catalog 'When this card is destroyed' vs printed 'If' and 'disappears' vs 'remove it from the game' are wording only. Artist only in subtitle.

name: Omnidirectional Patrolmajig
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Jack Heng
rules: If you are attacked and this card is depleted, you may restore this card.
notes: Catalog 'When you are attacked, you may restore this card' omits the printed 'and this card is depleted' condition; restoring a non-depleted card is a no-op so play is the same. Artist only in subtitle.

name: PantherKaiser
subtitle: the left flank of kaiser justice
rules: PANTHER SHIELD -- COST – Pay 2. Deplete this card. Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 3 life.
flavor: "If you need me, I'll be outside sitting on a stump or something."
notes: No Art: credit in footer.

name: Patent Enforcement
subtitle: stop! imposter! i already invented that!
rules: COST – Play this only in response to an item being played. Pay X, where X is that item's numeric cost. -- EFFECT – The item enters play under your control.
flavor: "That, too! And that!"
notes: Catalog uses deploy/deployed templating and 'its numeric cost'. No Art: credit in footer.

name: Quipmajig
subtitle: you're on the b-list now!
rules: INSULT -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a COVERT character. -- EFFECT – Deplete the character. This turn, the character cannot inflict damage.
flavor: "...so Mirgla's mother says, 'Yeah, and it's DEEP, too!'"
notes: Printed: 'the character cannot inflict damage'. Catalog: 'reduce all damage inflicted by it to 0' (not strictly identical: 'inflicts damage' triggers / 0-damage interactions).

name: Runic Field Enhancer
subtitle: d0n7 cr055 7eh 57r34mz
rules: UNIQUE RUNIC FIELD ENHANCER -- All your characters gain 1 strength and 1 life for each "gear" card you control.
notes: No Art: credit in footer.

name: Sagacious 31f
subtitle: come on guys! it'll be frickin' sweet!
rules: If an attacking party is formed including this card and at least 2 other characters, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand.
flavor: "You want how much to build it? And it does what?"
notes: Catalog: 'When ... you may search your deck for a card. If you do, put it into your hand.' Same play.

name: Schproingmajig
subtitle: wheeee! kill meeeee! yayyyy!
rules: PUMP-UP -- COST – Deplete another character you control. -- EFFECT – This turn, this card gains 2 strength and 2 life. -- SCHPROING! -- COST – Destroy a character you control. -- EFFECT – This turn, while this card is the only member of an attacking party it cannot be blocked.
notes: SCHPROING! effect prints 'while this card is the only member of an attacking party it cannot be blocked'; catalog just says 'This turn, this card cannot be blocked.' (missing the only-member condition).

name: Scorching Runicution
subtitle: that's not good...i'm not happy...ohhh nooo!
rules: COST – Pick a "gear" card. X is that card's numeric cost. -- EFFECT – Inflict X damage to the character to which the "gear" card is attached. Destroy the "gear" card.
flavor: The boiling fat drains out of this special chute.
notes: No Art: credit in footer.

name: Senior Research Assistant
subtitle: 1 5tuff3d 7h15 |/\|17h |V|y p00
rules: RESEARCH -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Reduce the next numeric cost you pay this turn by 2.
flavor: For F14xu5.
notes: Leetspeak subtitle transcribed best-effort (the N and M glyphs are |/\| and |V|). No Art: credit in footer.

name: Spackle
subtitle: whip it up thick, then spray it all over
rules: REPAIR -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a location. -- EFFECT – Remove 2 damage from the location.
flavor: "What did you think I meant?"
notes: Catalog says 'Remove 2 damage markers'; printed 'Remove 2 damage'. No Art: credit in footer.

name: T Force 5 Megabrutemajig
subtitle: smooshy crunchy!
rules: When this card enters play, you may detach up to 2 resources from your faction.
flavor: Mashy bashy!
notes: No Art: credit in footer.

name: T Force 5 Megadudemajig
subtitle: the dudemajig abides
rules: When this card enters play, you may detach up to 2 resources from your faction.
flavor: "Hey man, there's a beverage involved here!"
notes: No Art: credit in footer.

name: T Force 5 Megascoutmajig
subtitle: that's my good deed for the day
rules: When this card enters play, you may detach up to 2 resources from your faction.
flavor: You cannot defeat the Teenage Towering Titan Trampling Team. You can only hope to contain them.
notes: No Art: credit in footer.

name: The Whatever Device
subtitle: it's an easy fix
rules: THANK GOD WE INVENTED THE... -- COST – Pick a number for X. Pay X. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for an item with numeric cost X or less and reveal it. You may play that card for free. (You still need the proper resource icons and must pay any additional costs.) If you don't, put it into your hand.
notes: Catalog uses 'deploy' and omits the printed reminder text in parentheses. No Art: credit in footer.

name: Top-Secret Subterranean Goofarium
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Wang Hua
rules: COVERT characters cannot inflict damage to this card. -- If you are attacked, you may detach up to X resources from your faction, where X is the number of members in the attacking party.
notes: Catalog 'Characters with COVERT' / 'When you are attacked' = printed 'COVERT characters' / 'If you are attacked'. Artist only in subtitle.

name: Unrelenting Ridicule
subtitle: just ignore them
rules: COST – Pick a COVERT character. -- EFFECT – Destroy the character.
flavor: They'll get tired of it in a few hundred years or so...
notes: No Art: credit in footer.

name: Auction House
subtitle: get 'em while they're tasty!
rules: At the start of each player's turn, that player must reveal cards from the top of their deck until a character is revealed or no cards are left. If a character is revealed, players take turns bidding starting with the active player. Players cannot bid a number greater than the number of detached resources they control. Whichever player makes the winning bid pays that many resources and puts the character into play under their control. Shuffle all other revealed cards into their owner's deck.
notes: Catalog typo "owners's" (printed "owner's"); catalog 'that player reveals' vs printed 'must reveal'. No Art: credit in footer.

name: Cheats McGuillicutty
subtitle: wicked...tricksy...false...we hates him
rules: UNIQUE PLUCK -- The top card of your deck is revealed at all times. -- BOTTOM DEAL -- COST – Pay 1. -- EFFECT – Put the top card of your deck on the bottom. -- CHEAT -- COST – Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – You may look at and play the top card of your deck. -- CHANGE COSTUME -- COST – Pay 3. Shuffle this card into its owner's deck. -- EFFECT – Search your deck for a "pluck" card with a different name than this card and put it into play.
notes: CHEAT: printed 'You may look at and play the top card of your deck' (no reveal); catalog says 'Reveal the top card of your deck. You may deploy it. (You can't play resources with this ability.)' - reveal vs look at, plus an extra resource restriction not printed. CHANGE COSTUME: catalog adds 'and reveal it' and 'under your control'; printed just 'put it into play'. No Art: credit in footer.

name: Clockman Pickpocket
subtitle: you can always count on Dick for a surprise!
rules: While your opponent controls an item and this card is the only member of an attacking party, this card cannot be blocked. -- If this card inflicts damage to a faction, your opponent must pick an item they control. If they do, take control of that item and destroy this card.
flavor: Damn...I can't find the third rooster. I'll just have to improvise...
notes: Printed unblockable condition is 'while your opponent controls an item AND this card is the only member of an attacking party'; catalog omits the only-member condition ('cannot be blocked by that player'). No Art: credit in footer.

name: Counter Attack
subtitle: do you see what happens, Larry?
rules: COST – Play this only during your opponent's turn and not during a battle. -- EFFECT – Attack your opponent. Draw a card. (This effect only allows you to attack once. You must resolve the battle before you draw the card.)
notes: Catalog uses deploy / 'that player' / 'immediately and before you draw'. Same play. No Art: credit in footer.

name: Cute Cutpurse
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Henry Gunawan
rules: While your opponent controls an item and this card is the only member of an attacking party, this card cannot be blocked. -- If this card inflicts damage to a faction, you must pick an item your opponent controls. Destroy that item.
flavor: "I know who's been naughty!"
notes: Printed unblockable condition includes 'and this card is the only member of an attacking party'; catalog omits it ('cannot be blocked by that player'). Artist only in subtitle.

name: Early Retirement
subtitle: doing the bull dance, feeling the flow, working it
rules: COST – Pick a character you control. X is that character's strength. Destroy the character. -- EFFECT – Draw X cards.
flavor: "Oh, Señor John! You are hairy like beast!"
notes: No Art: credit in footer.

name: Epic Turncoat Maneuver
subtitle: curse your sudden but inevitable betrayal!
rules: COST – Destroy 2 characters you control. Pick 4 or fewer characters. -- EFFECT – Take control of the picked characters.
flavor: He'd be such a good Lieutenant if he'd just stop stabbing us!
notes: No Art: credit in footer.

name: Fool's Gold
subtitle: it's something for an executive
rules: TRADE -- COST – Pick an item your opponent controls. Pay X, where X is that card's numeric cost. Destroy this card. -- EFFECT – Take control of the item.
flavor: "'Scuse me, my good man, I have five hundred dollars to blow. What've you got?"
notes: Catalog 'an opponent controls' vs printed 'your opponent controls'. No Art: credit in footer.

name: Forcible Depredator
subtitle: move the thing...and...that other thing...move it!
rules: PLUNDER -- COST – Pay 2. Discard a card. Deplete this card. -- EFFECT – Put the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck into their discard pile.
notes: Catalog 'an opponent's deck' vs printed 'your opponent's deck'. No Art: credit in footer.

name: Fwing!
subtitle: fly, little brother! bring us back a shiny!
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – This turn, the character gains 1 speed. Flip a coin. If you win, the character also gains 1 strength this turn.
notes: No Art: credit in footer.

name: Gang Leader
subtitle: we'll give you a horse of your own...
rules: When this card enters play, all your characters gain 1 speed this turn.
flavor: ...right after your "initiation."
notes: No Art: credit in footer.

name: Hasty Sarcophyle
subtitle: he's hasty. and a sarcophyle.
flavor: Man, that is one hasty sarcophyle. Whoosh.
notes: No rules text printed (flavor only), matches catalog (none). No Art: credit in footer.

name: Hollow Moose
subtitle: i think it's about a moose that turns invisible
rules: This card enters play under your opponent's control. -- At the start of your turn, your faction loses 1 influence. -- INFILTRATE -- COST – Destroy another item or character you control. -- EFFECT – Your opponent takes control of this card.
flavor: ...and goes back in time for some reason.
notes: Catalog uses 'an opponent' and adds 'Pick an opponent ... That player takes control' for multiplayer templating. No Art: credit in footer.

name: Hulking Vigilante
subtitle: distributor of pain
rules: If you control any other characters you own, destroy this card.
flavor:
I am the terror that stalks in the street.
I am the dragon that lives in the slums.
I am the ogre that hammers the lawless.
I am the last thing you'll ever see.
notes: Catalog 'When you control' vs printed 'If you control'. Flavor is four separate printed lines (\n between). No Art: credit in footer.

name: Impeccable Timing
subtitle: i'm sorry sandwich!
rules: COST – Pick a depleted character. -- EFFECT – If the character has 4 life or less, destroy it.
flavor: This happens more often than you'd think.
notes: No Art: credit in footer.

name: Late Addition
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Sonny Liew
rules: You may play a character card from your hand. Draw a card. (You still pay all the character's costs.)
notes: Catalog uses 'deploy' for 'play'. Artist only in subtitle.

name: Martial Artist
subtitle: you suckers got nothing
rules: Your opponent cannot pick this card.
flavor: "Now are you boys gonna put down the weapons or do I have to keep embarrassing you..."
notes: Catalog 'Your opponents cannot pick this card' vs printed 'Your opponent cannot pick this card'. No Art: credit in footer.

name: Martial Arts Master
subtitle: try? do or do not. there is no try.
rules: While this card is in a battle, it gains X strength, where X is this card's speed minus the highest speed among characters in the opposing party.
flavor: "Judge me by my size, do you?"
notes: Catalog adds 'and there is at least one character in the opposing party' condition not printed on the card (affects the no-opposing-characters case). No Art: credit in footer.

name: Martial Arts Trainee
subtitle: stronger, faster, more powerful than before
rules: Your opponent cannot pick this card.
flavor: "Good! Now help me move this training dummy back into the storeroom."
notes: Catalog 'Your opponents cannot pick this card' vs printed 'Your opponent'. No Art: credit in footer.

name: Master Thief
subtitle: getting there is easy; getting away is the trick
rules: If this card is destroyed, you may pick a character, item, location, or resource in your opponent's discard pile. If you do, put that card into play under your control.
notes: Catalog 'a non-tactic card in an opponent's discard pile' = printed list 'character, item, location, or resource'. No Art: credit in footer.

name: Mendacious Brigand
subtitle: love of my life, breathe deep the sweet perfume
rules: If this card is blocked, you may pick a blocking character and a character your opponent controls that is not in a battle. If you do, remove the blocking character from the battle and add the other character to the blocking party.
notes: Catalog 'a character that character's controller controls' vs printed 'a character your opponent controls'. No Art: credit in footer.

name: Mercenary's Creed
subtitle: limited edition artwork by Chris de Joya
rules: ATTACH TO CHARACTER -- BRIBE -- COST – Both players may use this ability. Pay 3. -- EFFECT – Take control of the attached character. -- BLACKMAIL -- COST – Use this only if you own this card. Pay 2. -- EFFECT – Take control of the attached character.
notes: Catalog 'Any player may use this ability' vs printed 'Both players may use this ability'. Artist only in subtitle.

name: Misappropriation Machine
subtitle: we've got theftbots, pilfermajigs...
rules: STEAL -- COST – Deplete this card. Pick a character or item in your opponent's discard pile. -- EFFECT – Put the character or item into play under your control. Your opponent takes control of this card.
flavor: ...and even a dusty old yoinkmotron.
notes: Catalog 'an opponent's discard pile' / 'That card's owner takes control' vs printed 'your opponent's' / 'Your opponent takes control' (same in 2-player). No Art: credit in footer.

name: Orgy Den Smoke Out
subtitle: gold and finery, just slightly soiled
rules: Your opponent must discard a card at random. Put the top 2 cards of their deck into their discard pile.
notes: Catalog 'An opponent discards a card at random' vs printed 'Your opponent must discard a card at random'. No Art: credit in footer.
